articles.title: Form 8K Clearfield Inc For: 20 October
Metaplanet Bitcoin Investment Clears Super League Shareholder Vote
articles.description: TL;DR: Super League shareholders have approved proposals connected to Metaplanet’s plan to contribute 2,100 BTC and cash to a new US-listed Bitcoin treasury platform. Metaplanet’s proposed American Bitcoin treasury vehicle has moved a step closer to reality, but the transaction has not yet closed. Super League Enterprise said shareholders approved the relevant proposals at their annual meeting on October 16, clearing an important hurdle in the arrangement announced earlier this year. Under the deal, Metaplanet’s US subsidiary would contribute 2,100 Bitcoin and $2.5 million in cash to Super League. After closing, the Nasdaq-listed company is expected to change its name to Superplanet and trade under the ticker SUPA. The arrangement gives the Japanese Bitcoin treasury specialist a potential US capital-markets platform, while Super League would retain its existing advertising and media business as an operating segment. Importantly, the shareholder vote is not the same as completion. Regulatory filings, Nasdaq requirements and other customary closing conditions remain outstanding, with the companies currently targeting the fourth quarter. The proposed structure also raises questions that extend beyond the Bitcoin price. Investors will need to watch how ownership is allocated, how additional capital could be raised and whether the operating business changes the risk profile of a Bitcoin-heavy public company. For now, the news is a procedural milestone in an unusual cross-border deal — not evidence that 2,100 BTC has already arrived on the balance sheet. Written by the News Desk and edited by Samuel Rae.

articles.title: EssilorLuxottica: Q3 2026 Revenue - Revenue growth at 9.0% in Q3, +7.2% at constant currency
articles.description: Revenue growth at 9.0% in Q3, +7.2% at constant currency Group revenue +9.0% to Euro 7,486 million in Q3, +7.2% at constant ER1on top of double-digit growth of last yearGroup revenue +6.8% to Euro 22,304 million in the first nine months of the year, +8.9% at constant ER1Direct to Consumer up 10.6%1 in Q3, with comparable-store sales3 at +6.8%Professional Solutions up 3.4%1, compared to double-digit growth of last yearAll the regions contributing to the Group’s growth, with EMEA DTC and Asia-Pacific up double digits1Traditional business (Eyecare & Medtech) marching at >6%1 pace in both three and nine monthsMyopia management portfolio up 24%1 in the three and nine monthsWearables (AI glasses and Nuance Audio) up 20%1 in revenue in Q3Nuance Audio Plus launched in mid-September, improving product effectiveness and user experience Paris, France (October 20, 2026 - 6:00 pm) - EssilorLuxottica announced today that consolidated revenue for the third quarter of 2026 reached Euro 7,486 million, representing a year-on-year increase of 7.2% at constant exchange rates1 compared to the third quarter of 2025 (+9.0% at current exchange rates). Francesco Milleri, Chairman and CEO, and Paul du Saillant, Deputy CEO at EssilorLuxottica commented: "Quarter after quarter, our Company continues to demonstrate the strength of its unique model. In the third quarter, we delivered 9% revenue growth, with all regions contributing and Asia-Pacific standing out with double-digit growth. Our eyecare, eyewear and medtech activities remained a powerful engine of growth, up over 6% in both the quarter and the first nine months of the year, while wearables’ revenue increased 20%, confirming the strong momentum behind this emerging category we continue to lead. Our myopia management portfolio continued its exceptional trajectory, growing 24% in both the quarter and year to date. As we head into the holiday season, new AI glasses launches and the rollout of Nuance Audio Plus are further strengthening our wearable portfolio, offering people new ways to engage with and navigate the world around them. We were also proud to see Stellest recognized by TIME among the Best Inventions of the Year, highlighting the impact our innovation has in addressing one of the most pressing health challenges of our time and improving the lives of millions of children worldwide. Above all, these achievements reflect the passion, talent and commitment of our people around the world. Their ability to strengthen the business that defines us today while accelerating our expansion across science, clinical care and surgery sets EssilorLuxottica apart and gives us great confidence in the future.” Attachment DOWNLOAD THE PRESS RELEASE
